description:
Implement the Flow lens (BacklogItems + ExecutionRecords with executes/follow_up edges, showing lifecycle progression) and Operations lens (Scenarios + ExecutionRecords + Runs with targets/spawned_run/executes edges).

Flow lens:
- shows BacklogItems and ExecutionRecords
- edges: depends_on, executes, follow_up
- purpose: lifecycle progression from backlog → execution → review → completion
- default filter: show items in active statuses (queued, in_progress, needs_review, needs_fixup), hide completed chains
- inspector actions: BacklogItem (queue, view execution history, follow-up), ExecutionRecord (view prompt trace, follow-up, retry, trigger review, cancel)

Operations lens:
- shows Scenarios, ExecutionRecords, Runs
- edges: targets, spawned_run, executes
- purpose: live operational state — what's running, what's healthy, what needs attention
- default filter: show only running/active entities
- connects to SSE stream endpoint (`GET /api/v1/graph/stream?lens=operations`) for real-time push updates
- open EventSource when lens is active, close on lens switch
- automatic reconnection with exponential backoff
- full-fetch fallback on reconnect before resuming stream
- inspector actions: Scenario (start, stop, restart, view logs), ExecutionRecord (view prompt trace, stop run, view logs), Run (stop, view in agent-manager)
name: swarm-manager-flow-and-ops-views
title: Implement Flow and Operations Views in the Graph Workspace
